infoPlist.NSCameraUsageDescription: MyFNG needs access to your camera to take photos of your vehicle for service inspections, before/after service documentation, and incident reports during pickup and delivery.
infoPlist.NSContactsUsageDescription: MyFNG needs access to your contacts so you can invite friends and share your referral code with them.
infoPlist.NSLocationWhenInUseUsageDescription: MyFNG uses your location to show nearby workshops, calculate accurate ETAs for vehicle pickup, track your service request, and help drivers reach your location.
infoPlist.NSLocationAlwaysAndWhenInUseUsageDescrip: MyFNG uses your location to notify you when you are near a MyFNG service center and help our team assist with walk-in visits when you opt in to nearby workshop alerts.
infoPlist.NSPhotoLibraryUsageDescription: MyFNG needs access to your photo library so you can attach existing photos of your vehicle for service requests, complaints, and inspection records.
infoPlist.NSPhotoLibraryAddUsageDescription: MyFNG needs permission to save photos to your library, such as service invoices, inspection reports, and vehicle documentation.

plugins.locationWhenInUsePermission: MyFNG uses your location to show nearby workshops, booking ETAs, and pickup tracking.
plugins.locationAlwaysAndWhenInUsePermission: MyFNG uses your location in the background to notify you when you are near a MyFNG service center (optional nearby workshop alerts).

plugins.contactsPermission: Allow MyFNG to access your contacts to invite friends via Refer & Rise.
